signals.title: @anduriltech: Conquering the next battlefield: Space. We bet our own money to rapidly design, build, test, and fly a fully integrated satellite. Last mont
signals.content: Conquering the next battlefield: Space. We bet our own money to rapidly design, build, test, and fly a fully integrated satellite. Last month, ANDURIL-216 reached orbit. Anduril, alongside a few core partners, went from clean sheet to on orbit in less than two years. All systems are nominal. We've made first contact and fully commissioned the bus, power distribution devices, and edge compute payload. The first calibrated images are in from all three payloads onboard the spacecraft: one long-wave infrared, two electro-optical. The firsts go beyond the vehicle. Our space team used Lattice to commission and task ANDURIL-216, the first time Lattice has commanded an on-orbit spacecraft. More to come.
signals.score_reason: Twitter/X discussion signal. Final score: 40. Freshness: source age 0.82d.
signals.brief_en: Anduril Tech has successfully launched ANDURIL-216, a fully integrated satellite, into orbit in under 2 years, achieving first contact and commissioning its systems, including edge compute payload and imaging capabilities.
signals.brief_ar: نجحت شركة Anduril Tech في إطلاق القمر الصناعي ANDURIL-216 المتكامل بالكامل إلى المدار في أقل من عامين، وحققت الاتصال الأول وتكليف أنظمتها، بما في ذلك حمولة الحوسبة الحدية وخصائص التصوير.
